videos.script:
Props travel one level at a time. {{props}} When a component deep inside the page needs something, every component on the way has to pass it on.

Context is the other way. {{context}} A component makes a value available to everything inside it, at any depth. Two new pieces of the planner get the planner itself that way, with no props at all.

Then what happens when nothing above has set it. {{missing}} The error is loud, and that is a good thing.

Then what a context can hold. {{holds}} An object whose fields change, yes. A number, no: you would get the number as it was, for ever.

And last, the reason context exists at all. {{server}} On a server, one copy of each module answers every visitor. You will watch a stranger get greeted with somebody else's name, and then fix it in three lines.
